phase_5_end_to_end_decomposition.adverse_event: Clot fragmentation leading to distal embolization during active retrieval pass

exact_sensor_input.modality: Traction-force sensing at delivery-catheter/proximal interface + impedance spectroscopy across engaged clot segment (Clotild-class guidewire electrodes) + aspiration-pressure transduction
specific_features: (i) Second derivative of traction force vs displacement ('force gradient stiffening' preceding brittle fracture)
(ii) Abrupt high-frequency force transients (>50 Hz content) indicating partial structural failure
(iii) Impedance spectral shift indicating loss of continuous conductive path through clot (fragmentation signature)
(iv) Aspiration-pressure fluctuation amplitude indicating clot integrity loss at catheter face
exact_sensor_input.geometry: Force measured proximally at microcatheter hub; impedance across 2-4 electrode pairs spanning clot-engaged wire segment; sampling >=100 Hz for force, >=1 Hz spectroscopy sweeps
exact_sensor_input.why_this_sensor_set: Fragmentation is a mechanical failure event; force and impedance are the two modalities that observe clot structural integrity directly and continuously during traction. Imaging cannot resolve sub-second fragmentation onset.

exact_inferred_state.latent_state: Friability index F — scalar summarizing clot's probability of brittle fracture under current traction load, plus structural integrity state S(t) tracking progressive failure
exact_inferred_state.inference_model: Hybrid: physics-based cohesive-zone/fracture-energy backbone + learned calibration from impedance spectra to clot composition (RBC/fibrin fraction modulates expected fracture toughness)

relaxed_assumptions: (a) Force measured proximally includes catheter-vessel friction, confounded with clot traction force — survives only if friction estimated via free-run baseline or distal force sensing added
(b) Impedance-composition mapping degrades with blood conductivity drift and temperature — needs in-vivo calibration
(c) Fracture toughness varies with loading rate — model must be rate-conditioned
survival_conditions: (1) Friction-decoupled force estimate achievable with <=15% error, demonstrated ex vivo
(2) Impedance-to-toughness mapping validated against tensile testing of >=50 human clots
(3) Prospective AUC of fragmentation prediction >=0.75 in animal model
identifiability_per_ce017.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE pending validation. If any survival condition fails, the latent state is INCONCLUSIVE and the loop dies at inference.

exact_adverse_event_prediction.event: Structural failure of engaged clot producing >=1 fragment that escapes aspiration/snares zone, within 30 seconds of current traction initiation
exact_adverse_event_prediction.horizon: 1-10 seconds ahead of fragmentation onset (real-time, intra-pass)
exact_adverse_event_prediction.output: Continuous friability-progression score with binary alert threshold; alert carries recommended action tag
exact_adverse_event_prediction.fp_fn_tolerance: Target sensitivity >=90% at specificity >=60%. FN is costly (embolization); FP cost is moderate (slower retrieval). Currently INCONCLUSIVE pending data.

action_on_alert: (1) Halt or halve traction speed immediately
(2) Ramp aspiration to maximum at engagement face to capture incipient fragments
(3) If friability score remains critical after 5s, abort pass, reposition balloon guide/distal access catheter more distally, then resume
exact_pre_event_intervention.why_this_intervention: Acts on two physical determinants of fragment escape: fragment kinetic energy (traction speed) and capture probability (aspiration/distal protection). Alternative interventions (pharmacologic adjuncts, device switching mid-pass) have latency exceeding 1-10s horizon.
exact_pre_event_intervention.timing_feasibility: All three actions execute in <2s and act strictly before fragmentation propagates, provided detection latency <1s. This is the crux feasibility claim — must be demonstrated in animal model.

exact_technical_clinical_effect.effect: Reduced number of new distal territory occlusions per procedure; improved final eTICI; reduced pass count secondary to fewer fragment-chase passes
exact_technical_clinical_effect.measurement: Intraprocedural angiography (new distal occlusion count, eTICI), post-procedural DWI lesion volume in new territories, 90-day mRS
exact_technical_clinical_effect.minimum_clinically_meaningful_effect: Absolute reduction >=8 percentage points in new distal embolization rate, OR mean DWI new-territory volume reduction >=30%
